flags.why: Calling someone a fool or idiot is derogatory, but the tags present it only as humorous.
flags.fix: Add derogatory to the existing tags.

flags.why: This remains a current Catholic term for a deacon, as shown in [contemporary diocesan usage](https://tgpsaigon.net/bai-viet/giao-xu-thanh-nguyen-duy-khang-hanh-huong-nam-thanh-77525).
The example defines a decagon instead of showing the word in use.
flags.fix: Em vẽ một hình thập giác trên giấy. = I drew a decagon on paper.

flags.why: The example explains what the ten directions are instead of using the word in context.
flags.fix: Ông thành kính lễ bái chư Phật thập phương. = He reverently bowed to the Buddhas of the ten directions.

flags.why: The example discusses the word as an old name rather than using it to refer to a cross.
flags.fix: Ông quỳ trước cây thập ác trong nhà nguyện. = He knelt before the cross in the chapel.

flags.headword: thắng về nội, thối về ngoại
flags.why: The example paraphrases the proverb instead of applying it to a situation.
flags.fix: Con giỏi thì anh bảo giống mình, con hư thì anh bảo giống vợ, đúng là thắng về nội, thối về ngoại. = When the child does well, you say they take after you; when they misbehave, you say they take after your wife—credit to the father's side, blame to the mother's.
